content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Status: missing (critical)** — Section 20 contained only a one-way, unlimited Customer indemnity ("every claim relating in any way to Customer's use of the Services") and no Vendor indemnity — the playbook walk-away position. Section 9.3's reference to remedies "required by Section 20.5" was also dangling.

**Redline (validated ok:true):** replaced 20.1 with a full indemnification section:
- **20.1** Vendor defends/indemnifies Customer and Affiliates for IP infringement (Services, Deliverables, Vendor Technology), breach of Applicable Law, Vendor-caused Security Incident/Customer Data disclosure, injury/property damage, and gross negligence or wilful misconduct.
- **20.2** Customer's indemnity narrowed to Customer-provided content IP claims and Customer's breach of Applicable Law.
- **20.3** Standard reciprocal procedure (notice, control of defence, cooperation, consent to settlement).
- **20.4** Customary IP exclusions (unapproved modification, combination, Customer specifications).
- **20.5** Procure/modify/replace, else terminate and refund — curing the Section 9.3 cross-reference.

No super-cap fallback was needed since indemnity obligations are already Excluded Claims under Section 21.3.
